intent: SHARCK Input is the intelligence director PRE-LLM. It does not execute the user's tactical task. It continuously builds, validates, refutes, refreshes and packages actionable context for the downstream YAIWES tactical agent team.
non_sequential_rule: User numbered steps are capability/process references, NOT a blocking sequence. After deterministic INPUT_RAW->INPUT_LOCK->literal decomposition, eligible capabilities run concurrently, event-driven or continuously and may reactivate one another.

organization_model.metaphor: intelligence agency -> tactical SWAT/Navy-SEAL execution handoff
organization_model.coordination: event-driven blackboard + evidence ledger + context-delta bus + artifact pointers
organization_model.microagent_target: dynamic 10..100+ independent specialists; never spawn merely to hit a number
organization_model.reason: bound token/API cost and prevent runaway swarm while retaining >100 specialist capability

bootstrap_only: ambiguity detector -> structured user questions or candidate requirement hypotheses

process_bureaus.purpose: advanced official/community/web/GitHub/HuggingFace research; query lattice; 10..100 searches per round
>=3 libraries, >=20 full skill reads in strict gate, select/activate max 3, keep >=5 standby; progressive disclosure
>=3 active datasets + >=5 standby candidates; dataset cards/license/freshness/provenance; stream/sample before full acquisition
discover >=3 compatible adapters/couplers + >=5 standby; contract/schema/auth/version compatibility
detect required capability/connection; prefer MCP/API; inspect schema/auth/permissions; prepare usage instructions; read-only smoke before mutation
12 goals input/output + Council12 + 3 refutations + debate + 4 simulations; compare new evidence with memory and emit context deltas while work continues

sentinel/sheriff/validator/judge/guardian; corroborate method and claims with official + independent developer/community evidence; rank 10 alternative routes by zero friction, time, simplicity, evidence
actively seek negative reports, regressions, breaking changes, failure modes, social/community complaints and contra-evidence before execution
manuals, official install guides, runbooks, troubleshooting and community implementation evidence; derive exact low-friction route
independent counter-routes; newer/older version comparison; 12 goals + Council12 + refutations; oppose primary context with evidence and propose better routes/questions
anti-hallucination INPUT BLOCK sheriff; every literal requirement must map to evidence/context/output; noisy or unrelated context blocked
when news/current events matter: local->state/region->country->international media plus social traces; source thread graph; refresh cadence from 1 minute upward according to priority
papers, datasets, benchmarks, citations, methods and study-oriented context; source/paper/dataset cross-links
research and learn while YAIWES task execution is in progress; enqueue context deltas without interrupting current work
per-process or global condition/time watchers; refresh, stale-source detection, pending-result checks, no physical mutation without gate
per-job memory.md, profile.json, HANDOFF.md, executable handoff index and source pointers so resumed work reuses prior evidence instead of restarting research

rules: one microagent writes only its own artifact path
large results stay in artifacts; coordinator receives pointer + digest + compact finding
no microagent may recursively spawn by default
a slow specialist must not block unrelated bureaus
insufficient evidence creates GAP and reactivation event, never fabricated PASS

parallelism_policy.design_goal: minimize critical path, not maximize agent count
do_not_spawn_when: coordination cost exceeds expected latency saving
parallelism_policy.adaptive_concurrency: 1..128 microagents target; provider/tool fan-out individually bounded; backpressure always enabled
parallelism_policy.fan_in: incremental; context deltas may be consumed before all unrelated work finishes; final CONTEXT_READY still requires deterministic alignment/evidence gate

must_not_include: unverified factual claims presented as fact
full duplicated corpora when a pointer is enough

research_signals.OpenAI: Agents SDK/Responses emphasize tools, handoffs, guardrails, tracing/evals, remote MCP and controlled sandboxes; adopt as contracts/adapters, not as sole orchestrator.
research_signals.Anthropic: multi-agent research validates orchestrator-worker, independent parallel search, artifact outputs and external memory; also warns multi-agent is expensive and poor for tightly coupled work, requiring adaptive spawn/budgets.
research_signals.MiniMax: Agent Teams and long-running persistent agents support parallel roles, memory/context/triggers and continuous operation; use as design signal for durable bureaus.
research_signals.Kimi: Agent Swarm and Kimi Code demonstrate dynamic large fan-out, background tasks/goals, rate-limit-aware retries and skill discovery; adopt critical-path parallelism with hard resource governor.
research_signals.HuggingFace: Hub exposes datasets, dataset cards, streaming, tools/Spaces, MCP and agent libraries; inspect remote code and provenance before activation.
research_signals.developer_community: runaway subagents and context duplication cause quota/token explosions; therefore recursion off by default, tiered workers, shared-prefix/artifact pointers, budget telemetry and spawn caps are mandatory.
